purpose: What is the chance the next workshop order arrives within the wait?
meaning: Multiply arrival rate by elapsed waiting time, exponentiate its negative to obtain survival, and subtract survival from one for cumulative arrival probability. Waiting duration differs from the number of events in a fixed interval.

definition.setting: A workshop receives independent arrivals under a chosen constant-rate model. Move the waiting threshold t, or change the assumed arrival rate λ. Gold marks the chance of an arrival by t; the remaining strip shows the chance of still waiting.
definition.formal_latex: F(t)=1-e^{-\lambda t},\quad S(t)=e^{-\lambda t},\quad f(t)=\lambda e^{-\lambda t},\quad \mathbb E[T]=\frac{1}{\lambda},\qquad t\ge0,\ \lambda>0.

signature.F(t): Probability that the next arrival occurs by the waiting threshold
signature.S(t): Probability of still waiting beyond the threshold
signature.T: Random waiting duration under the declared law

conditions: A constant-rate memoryless arrival model uses λ from 0.25 to 2 per min and t from 0 to 8 min. A finite displayed time window does not remove its mathematical tail. Mean wait is 1/λ min. The rate is fixed within a model and no actual workshop arrival process is certified.
